intent: Build and deploy the Gold Weekly Intelligence Dashboard MVP per owner-frozen SPEC.md: FastAPI backend with free-source collectors, 5-dimension bias engine with visible reliability, TPO/POC/VAH/VAL/VWAP/regime market structure from daily bars, Nuxt 3 single-page dashboard, scheduled reports (Asia/Bangkok), SQLite persistence, CME browser collector workflow for GitHub Actions with dry-run/mock mode, pytest coverage including no-look-ahead.
flow: Entry point: FastAPI HTTP API (/api/*) called by Nuxt 3 frontend and by APScheduler jobs in-process. Collectors (yahoo, fred, cftc, tvdataoption, cme_snapshots, manual_import) write typed rows + as_of into SQLite via store.py. Engine (structure.py, bias.py, report.py) reads only rows <= as_of and emits metrics + reliability. Scheduler triggers refresh+bias+report per SPEC section 7 cron. CME snapshots arrive out-of-band via GitHub Actions commits to the data branch, pulled by cme_snapshots collector.
scope_rationale: Micro route: spec, decisions and architecture are already frozen and ratified by the owner (SPEC.md verbatim + decisions.md); no open consequential scope. Owner-mandated flow (spec -> tasks -> implement one checkout -> independent QA in disposable clone) maps to playbook+matrix with compact convergence.
unknowns: Exact Yahoo/FRED/CFTC response schemas drift over time -> collectors normalize defensively and tests use recorded fixtures
Nuxt build memory on shared 8GB VPS -> mitigate with NODE_OPTIONS max-old-space-size and static build

conventions.rule: Engine functions take as_of and may only read rows with timestamp <= as_of
Missing or stale data reduces dimension reliability visibly; never silently neutral
conventions.plan_application: bias engine reliability field + data_freshness flags in every API payload

conventions.rule: CME data only via GitHub Actions browser collector; never scrape from the VPS (403 IP block + ToU)
conventions.plan_application: cme_snapshots.py only pulls committed JSON from data branch; workflow runs on GH Actions

conventions.rule: Gold-Sight-by-OI and xau-oi-lab have no license: approach reference only, zero code copying
conventions.plan_application: all code written from scratch; only TVdataOptionOI (MIT) used as dependency

conventions.rule: Weekly report text is formatted from engine-computed metrics; no LLM computes scores
conventions.plan_application: report.py pure string formatting of engine outputs
